rca_of_issue: User complaint 'QR code in Emergent preview panel is not working'. Root cause is NOT in the codebase — verified by 6 tests: manifest OK for both platforms, bundle OK for both platforms, backend OK, pytest OK, web OK, app.json OK. The QR generator itself lives in the external Emergent preview UI and is out of scope. Most likely user-side causes: (1) Expo Go on their phone is not on SDK 54, (2) their phone is on a network that cannot reach the preview URL, (3) the external QR panel is caching an old URL. Mitigation: user updates Expo Go, or types exp://fitpro-ecosystem-1.preview.emergentagent.com manually into Expo Go's 'Enter URL manually' field.
